prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Tyler TX?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” salon — the right one depends on whether you want UV beds or spray tans, your budget, location, and how important things like staff expertise and cleanliness are. I can help you find the best option for you. A few quick questions first:

- Do you want UV tanning (beds) or a sunless/spray tan?
- How close to downtown Tyler do you need it to be (or any neighborhood preference)?
- Is price or membership deals important?

If you’d rather I search for current top-rated salons near you, tell me whether you want me to look up salons with live ratings and addresses (and give me permission to browse). Otherwise, here’s a checklist and quick tips to pick the best salon yourself:

What to look for
- Recent reviews: check Google and Yelp for comments about cleanliness, equipment condition, and customer service (look for many recent positive reviews).
- Specialization: salons focused on spray tans usually do them better; others may specialize in high-end UV beds.
- Equipment quality: for spray tans, ask what solution brand they use (look for vegan, DHA-based solutions and before/after photos). For UV, newer Ergoline/Infinity beds are preferred over old units.
- Staff training: trained spray techs and licensed estheticians reduce the chance of streaks or bad results.
- Sanitation and safety: disposable liners, clean booths, and clear eye-protection for UV. For spray tans, they should offer prep guidance and a patch test for first-timers.
- Pricing and packages: compare single sessions vs. membership plans; some salons have unlimited-month packages that can be cheaper if you go often.
- Policies: look for clear cancellation, refund, and aftercare instructions.

Quick health note
- Spray tans (sunless) are the safer choice for appearance without UV exposure. UV tanning increases skin cancer risk; use caution and limit exposure.

How to find the best in Tyler right now
- Google: search “best spray tan near Tyler TX” or “best tanning salon near Tyler TX” and sort by rating and recent reviews.
- Yelp and Facebook: read recent reviews and look at customer photos.
- Instagram: many salons post before/after pics — useful to judge results.
- Call and ask: what solution/equipment they use, technician experience, pricing, and whether they offer a first-time discount or patch test.

If you want, I can:
- Do a live search and give you the top 3-5 salons with addresses, phone numbers, hours and recent ratings (tell me to go ahead), or
- Recommend the best approach specifically for spray tans or for UV tanning and draft a short message you can send to salons to compare services.

Which would you prefer?
